highlights: Cross-platform chat app (Android, iOS, Web) using Flutter
Physical server mode: Node/Express + MongoDB backend (no Firebase dependency)
Realtime messaging via Socket.IO with polling fallback
Media sharing (images, video, audio, documents) with upload progress
Local notifications on mobile (channels/sounds); browser notifications on web
User search, profiles, group management, admin panel
Web and native route parity (web-optimized chat list)
Android in-app update check (manual icon + auto-check on launch)

authentication: Token storage with server-side validation on launch
chats: Last message preview and unread counts
media: Upload progress UI and in-app previews
routing: Web uses ChatListScreenWebMongoDB; mobile uses ChatListScreenMongoDB
Settings and create-group exposed on both
update_system_android: AppBar update icon triggers version check against version_info.json
Auto-check on launch with interval control
Modal shows release notes and opens direct APK link

android.notes: Release APK build via flutter build apk --release; update system enabled

ios.notes: Build with flutter build ios --release and archive in Xcode

web.notes: Web-optimized chat list and route parity

release_notes: Initial 1.0.0: MongoDB backend, chat/media, notifications, admin panel, web parity, and Android update system
